mapper.select: SELECT pof.id, pof.purchase_order_id, pof.sys_file_id, pof.file_type, pof.remark, pof.create_by, pof.create_time, sf.file_name, sf.file_size, sf.content_type FROM wms_purchase_order_file pof LEFT JOIN sys_file sf ON pof.sys_file_id = sf.id WHERE pof.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId} ORDER BY pof.create_time DESC

SELECT pof.id, pof.sys_file_id AS sysFileId, sf.file_name AS fileName, sf.file_size AS fileSize, sf.content_type AS contentType, pof.file_type AS fileType, pof.create_time AS createTime FROM wms_purchase_order_file pof LEFT JOIN sys_file sf ON pof.sys_file_id = sf.id WHERE pof.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId} AND pof.file_type = #{fileType} LIMIT 1

SELECT pof.id, pof.sys_file_id AS sysFileId, sf.file_name AS fileName, sf.file_size AS fileSize, sf.content_type AS contentType, pof.file_type AS fileType, pof.create_time AS createTime FROM wms_purchase_order_file pof LEFT JOIN sys_file sf ON pof.sys_file_id = sf.id WHERE pof.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId} AND pof.file_type = #{fileType} ORDER BY pof.create_time DESC
